title: Leaving Rick and Joe Ruffino
summary: Ridgley demanded a release from Ruffino, leaving Johnny Adams; he left around Ruffino's 1962 death and hopes to regain his Rick songs after 27 years.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
